data.exact_reserve_text: The underwriting profit of GBP 18.6m in 2014 (2013, GBP 35.2m profit) benefited from benign large loss and catastrophe activity during the year, partially offset by increased expenses in the year. The result included a release from prior year reserves of GBP 33.6m (2013, GBP 35.3m release). This release is a result of the Markel strategy to reserve prudently together with the work of our claims department in dealing with claims in an expeditious manner.
data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 3000 reported a prior-year reserve release of GBP 33.6m (net) for the 2014 year, driven by benign large loss and catastrophe activity and favourable claims development aided by proactive claims handling and prudent reserving. No gross prior-year movement was explicitly disclosed in the notes, so the reported figure is the Managing Agent's stated release.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development was only explicitly quantified in the Managing Agent's narrative as a GBP 33.6m release; the technical provisions movement table reports total movements (which include current year changes) but does not separately disclose a gross prior-year-only movement. Therefore the prior_year_development_gbp_m value is the narrated NET release (negative=release). No gross prior-year movement figure was found in the notes or a gross claims development triangle in the provided pages.
